name: OCK
recent: OCK Group 于 2026 年 11 月宣布以约 3.278 亿令吉初始现金收购 EDOTCO 旗下柬埔寨电塔资产，并计划于 12 月 9 日召开第十五届常年股东大会。最新财报显示 2026 财年营收同比增长 24.2%，净利大幅增长。
notable: 初始现金代价约 8,100 万美元（约 3.278 亿令吉）。
2026 财年营收同比增长 24.2%，净利同比增长 384.6%。
risks: 收购事项需满足买卖协议的先决条件，最终代价将按现金、负债、营运资金等调整。
近期有多名董事及大股东申报持股变动。
earnings: 2026 财年（截至 6 月 30 日）营收为 2.2898 亿令吉，同比增长 24.2%；净利为 1,938.4 万令吉，同比增长 384.6%；净利率从 3.2% 提升至 8.5%。

recent_en: Latest results show FY2026 revenue up 24.2% year-on-year with net profit rising sharply.
notable_en: Proposed acquisition of entire equity interest in EDOTCO Holdings (Labuan) Limited for an initial cash consideration of about US$81.0 million (approx. RM327.8 million).
FY2026 revenue grew 24.2% year-on-year and net profit grew 384.6% year-on-year.
risks_en: The acquisition is subject to conditions precedent in the SPA, and the final consideration will be adjusted for cash, indebtedness, working capital and other items.
Several directors and a substantial shareholder recently reported changes in their interests.
earnings_en: FY2026 (ended 30 June) revenue was RM228.98 million, up 24.2% year-on-year; net profit was RM19.384 million, up 384.6% year-on-year; net margin improved from 3.2% to 8.5%.
